envelope_rule: Each claim is one historical or baseline proposition. Its source fact is distinct from its interpretation. text scopes are inclusive LF-terminated ranges; binary scopes are whole-file. Hashes identify bytes and do not prove semantic support.

claims.source_fact: The catalog entry gives id paladins-twin-soul, title Paladin's Twin-Soul, a realm/twin-soul description, a cover path, and status playable.
claims.interpretation: This establishes the frozen catalog identity only; it does not establish a current game route or runnable implementation.

claims.discovery_method: accepted historical record and direct-import trace
claims.source_fact: The historical component barrel re-exports PaladinsTwinSoulGame.
claims.interpretation: This is historical component packaging, not current export availability.

claims.discovery_method: direct import from accepted historical component
claims.source_fact: The module declares state with player HP/capture/twin-soul fields, enemies, bullets, vocabulary target index, score, playing/victory/defeat status, wave, game time, and answer counters; its initializer creates a four-by-six enemy formation with two first-row bosses and initializes playing state.
claims.interpretation: Historical state and initialization inventory only.

claims.discovery_method: direct import from accepted historical component and logic
claims.source_fact: The configuration sets a 390 by 844 game area, player initial HP three, automatic-fire interval 500ms, player/bullet movement values, four enemy rows and six columns, enemy speed and points, and render colors.
claims.interpretation: Historical configured values; no current tuning claim.

claims.discovery_method: direct import from accepted historical component
claims.source_fact: On a playing tick, horizontal input moves and clamps the player, non-diving enemies move horizontally and reverse at bounds, the player auto-fires when the configured interval passes, player bullets move upward, enemy bullets move downward, and bullets outside the extended vertical bounds are removed.
claims.interpretation: Historical simulation behavior only; no native input or observed frame behavior is claimed.

claims.discovery_method: direct import from accepted historical component
claims.source_fact: A player bullet within the module's proximity test removes a hit enemy and bullet, adds configured enemy points, and rescues the captured player by setting hasTwinSoul and clearing isCaptured when the hit enemy hasCapturedPlayer.
claims.interpretation: Historical collision/rescue rule only; it does not establish a user-selected target mechanic.

claims.discovery_method: direct import from accepted historical component
claims.source_fact: An enemy bullet near the player decrements HP and sets defeat at HP less than or equal to zero; a diving enemy near the player also decrements HP and can set defeat.
claims.interpretation: Historical damage and defeat guards only; terminal reachability is not observed.

claims.discovery_method: direct import from accepted historical component
claims.source_fact: When an isCapturing enemy meets its proximity and vertical conditions, the logic marks the player captured, marks that enemy as holding the player, restores the enemy position, assigns it the indexed vocabulary word, and assigns other enemies sampled non-target words.
claims.interpretation: Historical capture and vocabulary-label assignment only; random output and live presentation remain unobserved.

claims.discovery_method: direct import from accepted historical component
claims.source_fact: When no enemies remain while playing, the logic increments wave, target index, correctAnswers, and totalAttempts; it sets victory when the target index reaches vocabulary length, otherwise creates a fresh formation.
claims.interpretation: Historical wave and victory transition only.

claims.discovery_method: direct import from accepted historical component
claims.source_fact: calculateXP returns zero with no attempts; otherwise it adds correct-word base XP and conditional perfect-accuracy, at-least-half-health, and under-30-second bonuses, capped at ten.
claims.interpretation: Historical calculation source only; no completed result was observed.

claims.source_fact: The component defines start, playing, and ended phases; the start surface supplies Paladin's Twin-Soul, Gargoyle Defense, three defense/rescue/matching instructions, Auto-fire control text, and Begin Defense; the ended surface supplies Defense Successful!/Realm Overrun! titles, result subtitle branches, restart, and exit actions.
claims.interpretation: Historical authored copy and scene branches only; not browser observation.

claims.source_fact: startGame creates historical state and changes phase to playing; a requestAnimationFrame loop calls the tick with delta clamped to 50ms; victory or defeat changes phase to ended and invokes onComplete once with computed XP and accuracy; restart returns to start and exit assigns /student/games.
claims.interpretation: Historical component wiring only; no user action, terminal, callback, or navigation was observed.

claims.source_fact: The component observes container dimensions, uses the smaller width-to-game-width or height-to-game-height scale, and uses h-[75vh] with md:aspect-video and md:h-auto on its container.
claims.interpretation: Historical responsive composition source only; compact and wide behavior is unknown pending browser audit.

claims.source_fact: The playing branch renders a scaled Konva stage with target translation, bullets, enemy labels/capture indicators, player/twin-soul marker, wave/score/HP HUD, and a VirtualDPad whose dx updates dpad velocity.
claims.interpretation: Historical render and handler wiring only; no asset or live-input claim.

claims.source_fact: The historical locale page dynamically imports PaladinsTwinSoulGame without SSR, fetches the vocabulary API after a session user exists, renders loading/error/page chrome branches, and posts xp and accuracy to the completion API from its completion callback.
claims.interpretation: Historical route and request construction only; authentication, HTTP success, and current route existence are not established.

claims.source_fact: The historical vocabulary route exports GET from createVocabularyRoute(SAMPLE_VOCABULARY) and declares force-static.
claims.interpretation: Historical API wiring only.

claims.source_fact: The historical completion route exports POST from createCompleteRoute and declares force-static.
claims.interpretation: Historical endpoint wiring only; no request completion, persistence, or authorization result is claimed.

claims.discovery_method: direct import trace from historical logic
claims.source_fact: The historical logic test file contains assertions for initialization, movement bounds, controlled auto-fire, projectile movement/removal, enemy hit/score, diving damage, capture/rescue/vocabulary assignment, wave advance, and XP branches.
claims.interpretation: This records historical test assertions, not a test execution result or proof of runtime behavior.

claims.source_fact: The historical component test mocks input, sound, fullscreen, accessibility, and react-konva, then asserts initial title/button rendering, click transition to the mocked stage, and a rect count after start.
claims.interpretation: This records mock-based historical test assertions only; it is not browser proof.
